entries.title: PFS: First Publisher
entries.notes: Exact three FAT12 disks verified by independent extractors. Five FONT resource maps with 159 references. FONTMOVE describes HP soft font conversion. See acquisitions.md.

entries.title: Express Publisher
entries.notes: Application PDM and help identify version 1.00 and 1.0 respectively. The standalone native trial installed both extra faces, launched with FILES=20 and saved a synthetic EPD. Shared-mode installer offers a DMFONT.RES upgrade.

entries.title: DeskMate Q&A Write
entries.notes: QWD.DIS identifies version 1.00. QWD.EXE, QWD.PDM, DMTOQWD.PDM and six printer font libraries. Separate archive note documents a printer font library for the IBM ProPrinter.

entries.title: HomeWord II
entries.notes: HOMEWORD.PDM identifies Sierra On-Line HomeWord II 1.20 in both the nested disk image and install ZIP. HW2.EXE identifies runtime 03.03.01.

entries.title: DeskMate Form Finisher
entries.notes: FF.PDM identifies Power Up Software and Form Finisher 1.01. FF.EXE identifies runtime 03.03.01.

entries.title: Lotus Spreadsheet for DeskMate
entries.notes: LOTUS-DM.PDM identifies release 1.0. LOTUS-DM.EXE identifies Lotus Development and runtime 03.03.01. The second disk includes graph and translation modules.

entries.title: FilePro for DeskMate
entries.notes: FILEPRO.PDM identifies filePro for DeskMate and The Small Computer Company. FILEPRO.EXE identifies runtime 03.03.01. Product version and Professional edition equivalence remain open.

entries.title: Quicken for DeskMate
entries.notes: QDM.zip and quicken2.zip share the 03.02.00 launcher. Their Q.PDM members identify 2.0 Release 3 and Release 4 respectively. WinWorld lists 2.1, whose identity remains unverified locally.

entries.title: MemoryMate for DeskMate
entries.notes: MEMODM.PDM identifies DeskMate version 1.0 and names Broderbund as publisher. Its credits name Precept and Jim Bean.

entries.title: RightWriter
entries.notes: RIGHT.PDM inside the disk-image set identifies RightSoft and version 3.2, April 1989.

entries.title: Home Lawyer
entries.notes: Original synthetic legal-document examples only; not legal advice.

entries.title: CheckFree DeskMate
entries.notes: Offline configuration and format research only; do not connect to obsolete/live account services.

entries.title: Financial Assistant
entries.notes: TVDog identifies pfa.zip as Personal Financial Assistant. The inventory includes PFA.SML, PFADAT.SML, and PFAHLP.SML. The link between the archive edition and printed SKU remains open.

entries.title: Business Graphs
entries.notes: TVDog preserves graphs.zip and grafnote.zip. The program ZIP has INSTALL.PDM and SML payloads. Verify the payload title, version, and runtime.

entries.title: The Outliner
entries.notes: TVDog identifies outliner.zip and a separate notes PDF. The package contains OUTLIN88.SML and OUTLIN89.SML. Runtime differences and export formats remain open.

entries.title: Thesaurus Companion
entries.notes: TVDog identifies thes.zip and a separate manual. The archive contains DICT.SYN, DMTHES.RES, and THES.RES.

entries.title: Macros
entries.notes: TVDog identifies macros.zip as the Macro Companion. Its members include DMMACRO.ACC, DMMACRO.RES, and DMMACRO.HLP.

entries.title: DeskMate Home Organizer
entries.notes: The three preserved disk sets share an identical TOOLSLCT.PDM. Retail SKU and completeness remain open. The separate RSX OEM edition was observed opening the selector and Collections.

entries.title: Print Magic
entries.notes: Executable gives Epyx 1988 copyright; source readme claims DeskMate 3.00 to 3.02 compatibility. Two historical PMP pages start with PMPAGE and NUL.

entries.title: Instant Pages
entries.notes: IP.PDM declares 1.0. A hard-disk installer and 125 IPD members are preserved. Product copyright spans 1987 and 1988.

entries.title: The Music Studio
entries.notes: Two preserved program ZIPs and a manual ZIP are cataloged by TVDog. Disk 1 includes MSTUDIO.PDM and MUSIC.EXE. Exact product and version attribution remain open.

entries.title: Typing Tutor IV
entries.notes: Catalog associates DeskMate label; verify runtime/edition and data files.

entries.title: Backup Pro
entries.notes: BP.PDM declares 1.0 and the timer shows a 1989 copyright. The media includes standalone backup inspection tools.

entries.title: DeskMate Solitaire and Poker bundle
entries.notes: Two distinct PDM/EXE pairs with corresponding help files. Component product version and publisher open.

entries.title: StudyWare for Chemistry
entries.notes: Product identity and version verified in the installer. DeskMate relationship awaits inspection inside packed RED resources.

entries.title: StudyWare for Economics
entries.notes: Product identity and version verified in the installer. DeskMate relationship awaits inspection inside packed RED resources.

entries.title: StudyWare for the ACT
entries.notes: Product identity and version verified in the installer. DeskMate relationship awaits inspection inside packed RED resources.

entries.title: DeskMate ClipArt Editor beta
entries.notes: Packed PDM and documentation corroborate a contemporary forum description of the Draw Object to CLP workflow.

entries.title: UnDesk
entries.notes: The COM converter and readme describe exporting DeskMate DOC files to standard text. Product version and compatibility boundaries remain open.

entries.title: DM_Music
entries.notes: The original archive matches the November 18 private acquisition. The converter has an x86 GUI and a Visual Basic 6 runtime dependency, with a 1.04 PE version resource.

entries.title: DeskMate Development System
entries.notes: Development Guide and Technical Reference PDFs and DMDB header identities match local pins. PSSJ, Sound and Samples toolkits are independently indexed.

entries.title: DeskMate Workgroup Companion
entries.notes: The 1988 guide describes RS-232, TandyLink, and 3Com configurations. TVDog preserves deskwork.zip with WGSETUP.PDM and networking modules. The companion notes specify DeskMate 3.02+ and DOS 3.2+.

entries.title: SchoolMate
entries.notes: Page 9. Documented as DeskMate plus 3Com 3+Share with teacher and student tools. Runtime version and media not identified.

entries.title: Venture
entries.notes: Page 10 shows the DeskMate User Interface logo. Advertised with a business planner, word processor, spreadsheet, file manager and general ledger. Actual runtime unverified.

entries.title: PC-Link starter kit
entries.notes: Page 10 documents the retail terminal-and-service package. Other PC-Link release and DeskMate bundle identities require independent verification.

entries.title: The FUNdamentals for DeskMate
entries.notes: Pages 11 and 28 reverse the SL/TL assignment of SKUs 25-1233 and 25-1236. The separately listed 25-1186 HX/TX edition is not marked as using the DeskMate interface.

entries.title: MathTalk
entries.notes: Page 11 displays the DeskMate logo and gives 1988-10-30 as planned availability.

entries.title: KidTalk
entries.notes: Page 11 displays the DeskMate logo and gives 1988-10-30 as planned availability.

entries.title: Speller Bee
entries.notes: The DeskMate logo appears with SKU 25-1232 on pages 11 and 26. The guide gives conflicting availability dates, 1988-09-30 and 1988-10-30 respectively.

entries.title: SmoothTalker
entries.notes: Page 11 displays the DeskMate logo and page 26 binds the name to the same SKU. Planned availability 1988-10-30.

entries.title: Computer MAD LIBS
entries.notes: Page 11 displays the DeskMate logo and gives 1988-10-30 as planned availability.

entries.title: The Children's Writing & Publishing Center
entries.notes: Pages 11 and 29 display the DeskMate logo. The latter describes the DeskMate interface explicitly. Planned availability 1988-10-30.

entries.title: DeskHelp
entries.notes: DH-DEMO.EXE names Atmospheres and credits Bobby Ballard. TVDog describes compatibility with DeskMate 1 and II and excludes Personal DeskMate and DeskMate 3.

entries.title: Disk Info
entries.notes: DISKINFO.PDM identifies the program version and publisher. TVDog describes boot-sector inspection and excludes RAM disks.

entries.title: Kaleidocubes
entries.notes: KUBES.PDM matches the RSX and RLX HD-B copies by SHA-256. The KUB files and KUBES.HLP await format and behavior tests.

entries.title: Letter Invaders
entries.notes: LI.PDM matches the preserved RSX and RLX HD-B copies. The prior RSX investigation reached About and the play instructions. Udut also associates the game with Typing Tutor IV, whose distribution remains unverified.

entries.title: Pocket Watch
entries.notes: POCKET.PDM identifies version 3.1. POCKET.DOC describes DeskMate 3 and standalone modes. The nested POCKET.EXE banner identifies runtime 03.03.01.

entries.title: Recipe Sharing for Home Organizer
entries.notes: TVDog specifies Home Organizer. The archived RCPSHARE.PDM differs from the common RSX and RLX HD-B member. Edition and feature equivalence remain open.

entries.title: Fil2dbf
entries.notes: FIL2DBF.TXT documents DeskMate 3 database export to dBASE III/IV. The second archive provides a DOS runtime.

entries.title: DBrepair
entries.notes: DBREPAIR.PDM matches the copy bundled with Fil2dbf. Its documentation specifies DeskMate 3.0 or later.

entries.title: Filer ASCII conversion utility
entries.notes: FILER.BAS and FILER.DOC describe two-way conversion between early Filer databases and delimited text. TVDog excludes DeskMate 3.

entries.title: Hmw2txt
entries.notes: The package readme and C source identify a command-line converter from Sierra HomeWord for DeskMate to plain text.

entries.title: Prn2file
entries.notes: PRN2FILE.TXT identifies version 2. The DOS executable and C source convert DeskMate print-to-file report output to text.

entries.title: BackupDM
entries.notes: The batch file and menu helper back up selected types of DeskMate data to floppy from a fixed installation path.

entries.title: Dmgif
entries.notes: The 0.9 package includes DMGIF.PDM. The 1.2 three-part set contains both DMGIF.EXE and DMGIF.PDM, with documented DeskMate 3.0x and standalone DOS installation choices.

entries.title: Dmsound
entries.notes: DMSOUND.DOC specifies DeskMate 3.00+ or DOS 2.11+ with the extra runtime package. Hardware drivers are present.

entries.title: Mavis Beacon Teaches Typing for DeskMate
entries.notes: The installed-copy ZIP contains MAVIS.PDM 1.31T and a launcher with runtime banner 03.03.01. TVDog describes copy protection and TransCopy hardware for the distribution disks.

entries.title: Convert (Mac sound to DeskMate)
entries.notes: CONVERT.DOC describes rewriting the source audio header for DeskMate Sound. The archive includes CONVERT.EXE.

entries.title: Conv2snd
entries.publisher: Kenneth Udut and Jeffrey L. Hayes
entries.notes: CONV2SND.DOC identifies version 2.02 and both contributors. Pascal source, the DOS converter, and a separate SND-to-WAV utility are present.

entries.title: Prtsnd
entries.notes: PRTSND.COM and its assembly source accompany TVDog's entry for printing uncompressed Tandy SND waveforms on compatible dot-matrix printers.
